meta.purpose: Aerial view of the entire proposed Virgil editor skill set, organized for visualization and cross-cutting analysis.
meta.naming_convention: Uniform <verb>-<noun> per Decision A; existing skills renamed with old names kept as aliases for one release cycle.
meta.granularity_principle: Decision C: split when commandments/preservation rules differ; parameterize when only output shape differs.
invocation_surfaces: A: UI-initiated (note-card-based — general note or selection note)

families.name: Umbrella
families.description: Cross-cutting orchestrators that dispatch to other skills.

families.name: Card creation (create-X namespace)
families.description: Creating new cards across panels. Per Decision C: split for kinds with substantive differences, parameterize uniform ones.

families.name: Card-agnostic operations
families.description: Move, archive, restore, link — parameterized by ontology (apply uniformly to all card kinds).

families.name: Responders
families.description: Answer existing user-authored cards (notes, todos, cutter-comments, revision-comments) flagged for AI.

families.name: Library-facing research
families.description: Skills that pull library content INTO the writing process (research, verify claims, surface related sources).

families.name: File prep / ingestion
families.description: Translate externally-authored .tex losslessly into Virgil-compatible form (gb4e → expex, custom macros, bib system swaps, etc.).

families.name: Revision (revise-* namespace)
families.description: Structured revision skills organized by intervention level. Inherits 12 revision commandments.

families.name: Dev meta
families.description: Skills for iterating on the skill set itself, plus the dev-dream phase.

intervention_levels.mid: Tighten without restructuring (cut hedges, compress, cut filler)
intervention_levels.structural: Reorganize but preserve sentences (flow, paragraphs, transitions)
intervention_levels.generative: Add new material (from notes, expand, add example, add counter)
intervention_levels.free: Any of the above as needed; first move is propose-what-it-would-do

skills.name: review
skills.description: Walk the unified AI-request inbox; dispatch each Task to its specialist skill as a subagent.
skills.notes: The skill the user invokes 95% of the time. Calls every other skill as a subagent.

skills.name: create-footnote
skills.description: Draft a footnote body, insert \footnote{} Atom at the anchor in .tex, write a FootnoteRef card.

skills.name: create-citation
skills.split_reason: External source search (Crossref/OpenAlex/Semantic Scholar/arXiv) + bib entry creation
skills.description: Search external sources for a paper matching the user's description; add to references.bib; create CitationRef card.

skills.name: create-quotation
skills.split_reason: Quote extraction / verification; fair-use brevity constraints
skills.description: Assemble a QuotationGroup nesting references + quotes + anchor links.

skills.name: create-card
skills.parameterize_reason: Same commandments + writeback shape; only body shape differs by kind
skills.description: Create a new card of the specified kind at the given anchor.

skills.name: create-revision-suggestion
skills.split_reason: Carries prominent 'Virgil as author' UI mark; behavioral fork in apply_response
skills.description: Propose a revision to a paragraph. Always emits a RevisionSuggestionCard with author='virgil'.
skills.notes: v2: largely subsumed by revise-free (which handles 'improve this' chat asks). Kept distinct in v1.

skills.name: create-cut-suggestion
skills.split_reason: Carries prominent 'Virgil as author' UI mark
skills.description: Propose a cut or rewrite of an existing excerpt in the Cutter panel.

skills.name: edit-card
skills.parameterize_reason: Same commandments across kinds; only target card body shape differs
skills.description: Modify an existing card's body or fields.

skills.name: archive-card
skills.parameterize_reason: Mobility affordance is uniform across ontology
skills.description: Move a card to the archive panel.

skills.name: restore-card
skills.description: Restore a card from the archive to its prior panel.

skills.name: move-card
skills.description: Re-anchor a card to a different paragraph (TextObject) or atom.

skills.name: link-cards
skills.description: Create a relationship link between two cards.

skills.name: answer-note-request
skills.description: Answer a flagged note. Drafts a sibling note OR a revision-suggestion if the user asked for a doc edit.

skills.name: answer-todo-request
skills.description: Classify a flagged todo as a text-edit, missing-artifact, analysis, or limit; dispatch accordingly.

skills.name: answer-cutter-comment
skills.description: Respond to a flagged Cutter-panel comment by drafting a CutterSuggestionCard.

skills.name: answer-revision-comment
skills.description: Respond to a flagged Revisions-panel comment. Sibling comment OR revision-suggestion if doc edit asked.

skills.name: answer-bib-review
skills.description: Three-mode: verify/fill fields against external sources, draft an annotation, or swap a library entry (--library-sync).

skills.name: sync-bib-to-library
skills.description: Reconcile the paper's bibliography against the user's Virgil Library: swap matched entries, triage missing, flag ambiguous.

skills.name: style-merge
skills.description: Merge user preamble customizations onto a target style. Rewrites .tex; body untouched.

skills.name: research-paragraph
skills.description: Walk the paragraph's anchored citations; check whether assertions match what cited sources actually say. Surface tension as a note.

skills.name: find-source
skills.description: Given a stated claim, search the user's library for supporting or contradicting papers. Returns ranked candidates.

skills.name: extract-quote
skills.description: Pull quotable passages from a named library paper on a given topic. Differs from create-quotation: user names the source, Virgil finds the quote.

skills.name: summarize-source
skills.description: Surface the library's annotation for a cited source, or generate one from the source text.

skills.name: check-citation-fit
skills.description: For each anchored citation in the paragraph: does the source actually support the claim it's anchored to? Surfaces mismatches.

skills.name: related-from-library
skills.description: Suggest related library papers that aren't yet cited in the paragraph.

skills.name: triangulate
skills.description: For a given claim, find library papers that agree, disagree, or qualify. Useful for building footnotes or strengthening arguments.

skills.name: preflight
skills.description: Non-destructive scan of an externally-authored .tex file. Reports every construct needing conversion (auto / requires-decision / refuses).

skills.name: prep-file
skills.description: Umbrella: runs preflight, then dispatches to per-construct converters. Produces a Virgil-compatible paper folder.

skills.name: convert-examples
skills.description: Convert gb4e / linguex / \enumsentence-style examples to expex. Shared with library di-examples.

skills.name: expand-macros
skills.description: Inline-expand unsafe \newcommand definitions; preserve safe ones. Reports which.

skills.name: migrate-preamble
skills.description: Move externally-authored preamble onto a Virgil style. Sits upstream of style-merge.

skills.name: migrate-bib
skills.description: Handle natbib ↔ biblatex swaps, \bibliography{} ↔ \printbibliography, bibstyle differences.

skills.name: quarantine-tikz
skills.description: Move inline TikZ / pgfplots / drawing code to external files; insert \input{}. Body stays parseLatex-friendly.

skills.name: revise-dictation
skills.description: Fix dictation errors, complete sentence boundaries, resolve homophones.

skills.name: revise-typos
skills.description: Typos + punctuation + capitalization only. Nothing else moves.

skills.name: revise-incomplete
skills.description: Find unfinished sentences; complete or flag.

skills.name: revise-cut-hedges
skills.split_reason: Distinct preservation rule: hedges that do epistemic work stay
skills.description: Remove 'perhaps,' 'arguably,' etc. unless doing real epistemic work.

skills.name: revise-cut-throat-clearing
skills.description: Strip 'Importantly,' 'In this paper, I will argue,' etc.

skills.name: revise-cut-redundancy
skills.description: Same point made twice → kept once; surfaces which.

skills.name: revise-compress
skills.description: Compress to a target word count or percentage. Reports what was sacrificed.

skills.name: revise-cut-filler
skills.description: Adverbs that don't earn it ('very', 'really', 'actually').

skills.name: revise-flow
skills.description: Reorder sentences/paragraphs for argument flow. Sentence content unchanged.

skills.name: revise-paragraphs
skills.description: Split overlong paragraphs; merge fragmented ones. Sentence content unchanged.

skills.name: revise-transitions
skills.description: Add/strengthen transitions only. Existing prose untouched.

skills.name: revise-topic-sentences
skills.description: Extract or compose topic sentences for paragraphs that bury them.

skills.name: revise-make-explicit
skills.description: Flag and (optionally) make explicit unstated premises, jumps, assumptions.

skills.name: revise-clarify-claims
skills.description: Find vague claims; tighten or flag for citation.

skills.name: revise-disambiguate
skills.description: Find pronouns + references the reader might trip over.

skills.name: revise-strengthen-weak-points
skills.description: Find load-bearing argument moves; surface where under-supported.

skills.name: revise-voice-match
skills.description: Match surrounding text's voice when a paragraph reads off-key.

skills.name: revise-register
skills.description: Formal ↔ conversational on user request.

skills.name: revise-de-AI
skills.description: Remove AI tells if Virgil-authored or external AI content slipped in.

skills.name: revise-from-notes
skills.description: Turn dictated/scribbled notes into prose. More aggressive than revise-dictation; allowed to reorganize.

skills.name: revise-expand
skills.description: Thin paragraph → full. User flags direction (more evidence / example / counter).

skills.name: revise-add-example
skills.description: Find abstract claims; propose concrete examples (as proposals; user accepts).

skills.name: revise-add-counter
skills.description: Propose a counter-consideration the argument should address.

skills.name: revise-free
skills.description: Any of the above. First move: propose what it would do; ask for confirmation before doing it. Replaces generic 'improve this'.
skills.notes: The discovery surface — when in doubt, this is what the user invokes.

skills.name: revise-to-thesis
skills.description: Extract a one-sentence thesis.

skills.name: revise-to-bullets
skills.description: Prose → bullets for outline/reorg.

skills.name: revise-to-summary
skills.description: Target word count summary.

skills.name: revise-compare
skills.description: Propose 2-3 alternative revisions side-by-side; user picks or hybridizes.

skills.name: revise-explain
skills.description: For an existing revision, articulate why each change was made.

skills.name: revise-with-feedback
skills.description: User rejects with reason; feedback becomes a flagged user-dream memo.

skills.name: iterate-virgil-editor
skills.description: Stress-test the editor skill set in a sandboxed sample paper. Synthesizes test cases, runs target skill via subagents, reads critique memos, edits skill markdown, loops.

skills.name: dream
skills.description: Overnight autonomous pass. Reads DEV-mode memos; refactors/edits skills, scripts, manifest. Acts-directly for small changes; proposes-via-worktree for substantive ones.

helper_scripts.name: _common.py
helper_scripts.purpose: Shared utilities (path resolution, JSON I/O, paragraph UUID regex, notification append, version bump).

helper_scripts.name: apply_response.py
helper_scripts.purpose: The single sanctioned writeback. New subcommands (complete-task / write-with-comment / write-silent) + --synthesize-task flag + pen-acquire/release wrapping.

helper_scripts.name: list_requests.py
helper_scripts.purpose: Unified JSONL inbox across ai-requests.json + bib-review-requests.json + card flags.

helper_scripts.name: get_para_context.py
helper_scripts.purpose: Paragraph by UUID + neighbors.

helper_scripts.name: cards_for_paragraph.py
helper_scripts.purpose: Every card anchored to a given paragraph UUID, across all panels.

helper_scripts.name: bib_resolve.py
helper_scripts.purpose: Parse a references.bib entry and its annotation.

helper_scripts.name: bib_match_library.py
helper_scripts.purpose: Classify paper bib entries vs the library (matched / missing / ambiguous).

helper_scripts.name: rename_citekey.py
helper_scripts.purpose: Rewrite \cite*{} commands in tex + citations.json when a citekey changes.

helper_scripts.name: library_path.py
helper_scripts.purpose: Library-path resolution chain.

helper_scripts.name: card_by_id.py
helper_scripts.purpose: Fetch any card by UUID across panels.

helper_scripts.name: paragraph_by_uuid.py
helper_scripts.purpose: Get paragraph by UUID without full context load.

helper_scripts.name: find_anchor.py
helper_scripts.purpose: Reverse lookup: which paragraph contains this text? Resolver, not guesser — returns candidates if ambiguous.

helper_scripts.name: walk_doc.py
helper_scripts.purpose: Emit the whole document as a structured tree: sections → paragraphs (with UUIDs) → anchored cards.

helper_scripts.name: card_history.py
helper_scripts.purpose: Walk a card's edit + accept/reject history by joining sidecar with ai-requests rows by resultId.

helper_scripts.name: orphan_check.py
helper_scripts.purpose: Find cards with stale anchors, footnotes without anchor commands, stale suggestion cards. The gardening primitive.

helper_scripts.name: citations_used.py
helper_scripts.purpose: List citekeys actually used in the doc body.

helper_scripts.name: panel_summary.py
helper_scripts.purpose: Quick count + recent activity per panel.

helper_scripts.name: inbox_history.py
helper_scripts.purpose: Drains ai-requests.json history into a 'what landed' view. Filterable by safety level. The audit-log surface.

helper_scripts.name: card_search.py
helper_scripts.purpose: Full-text search across all sidecars + inbox history.

helper_scripts.name: latex_normalize.py
helper_scripts.purpose: Shared with library: gb4e→expex, custom-macro inlining, bib-system swaps. Imported by both prep family (editor) and di-examples (library).

helper_scripts.name: library_query.py
helper_scripts.purpose: Read-only library access for the research family: fetch_paper, fetch_annotation, search_master_bib, search_library_text.

helper_scripts.name: pen.py
helper_scripts.purpose: Pen acquire/release for the editing lock. Implemented inside apply_response.py's atomic-write primitive; not a separately-callable script.

coverage_matrix_summary.description: Card-kinds × operations coverage after the full proposed set lands. Rows are Card kinds; cells indicate which skill (if any) covers that operation.
coverage_matrix_summary.notes: All card kinds get create + edit + archive + restore + move + link coverage. Responders (answer-*) cover the 4 user-flagged kinds. BibEntry has its own specialized skills (answer-bib-review, sync-bib-to-library).
